To,
AII ACC (HQ)(Zones)/ACC(Zones),

Subject: Additional charge to Accounts Officers in the absence of sufficient number
of APFCs in the Office- reg

Madam/Sir,

It has been decided by the competent authority that RC-I(OIC)/RC-II(OIC) may
assign additional charge of Accounts, Cash and/or Pension Sections to the Accounts Officers
(AOs) working under administrative control of the concerned RO with the prior approval of
Zonal ACC(HQ)/ACC for a maximum period of 45 from the issuance of this order with the

following conditions:

i. Additional charge should be given to Account Officers only upto the number of
vacancies existing in APFC/RPFC-II cadre.
il. It may be ensured that seniority and suitability for working on sensitive posts is

given due consideration.

(This issues with the approval of Central P.F. Commissioner)

Copy to:

All Officer-in-Charge of Regional Offices - for information.
